description: Invalid examples. Each case starts from a valid example (base), removes the listed JSON Pointers in order, then sets the listed values; the result must be rejected by the base's contract.

cases.name: report-unscoped-finding
cases.reason: A finding ID must be scoped to its review, not a bare local ID.

cases.name: report-receiver-field
cases.reason: Receiver-side fields (feature point IDs) are never part of the report.

cases.name: report-merged-success-state
cases.reason: Execution and acceptance stay separate; there is no merged 'success' state.

cases.name: report-ui-as-framework-score
cases.reason: Business UI is never counted as a framework score.

cases.name: report-double-counted-build
cases.reason: One report describes exactly one business build.

cases.name: receipt-accepted-not-stored
cases.reason: Only a stored result is a receipt; 'accepted' is not persistence.

cases.name: receipt-missing-identity
cases.reason: A receipt names the run it stored.

cases.name: bundle-manifest-path-escape
cases.reason: Bundle paths never leave the bundle.

cases.name: batch-hides-samples-with-global-score
cases.reason: A batch lists every planned sample and computes no global score.

cases.name: batch-parallel-samples
cases.reason: v1 runs one sample chain at a time.
